general_information.Syllabus Name: Excel Skills for Business_Kỹ năng Excel ứng dụng trong kinh doanh
general_information.Description: In this course, students will learn the essentials of Microsoft Excel. Students will be able to expertly navigate the Excel user interface, perform basic calculations with formulas and functions, professionally format spreadsheets, and create visualizations of data through charts and graphs. Students will also build a solid layer of more advanced skills so they can manage large datasets and create meaningful reports. These key techniques and tools will allow students to add a sophisticated layer of automation and efficiency to everyday tasks in Excel.
general_information.StudentTasks: 1. Complete the online courses and get the two Coursera's course certificates to be allowed to take Final Exam 2. Final Exam is included of Final Theory Exam (TE) & Final Practical Exam (PE): 100% 3. Student gets 0.5 bonus points for each course completed on time. 4. Completion Criteria: Final TE Score >=4 & Final PE Score >=4 & ((Final TE Score + Final PE Score)/2 + bonus) >= 5 5. In the case: (5 > Final TE Score >=4) & (5 > Final PE Score >=4) & ((Final TE Score + Final PE Score)/2 + bonus) < 5, the student can choose to take the resit of both TE & PE OR just either TE or PE.
